Castro's page of one episode, recorded once on 2026-10-30 with the Pinakes user agent
(`pinakes/0.1.0 (+https://pubky.app; info@synonym.to)`), for `pinakes_core::sources::castro`'s page
hook; test runs make no requests. The page is gzip-compressed, as served apart from that.

It is Darknet Diaries' "Conti" (`/episode/A1tnxb`): its player plays the show's own enclosure,
and its "Listen on" links name the show's Apple ID (1296350485).
